``````## Motion: Save the KongSwap DAO by Transferring SNS Management to Doxa Foundation

The KongSwap team has announced the sunsetting of the project and instructed liquidity providers to withdraw by April 6th. The DAO is now at risk of losing its entire user base, liquidity, and brand.

The Doxa Foundation has publicly offered to **take over and continue running KongSwap** (see full statement linked above).

This Motion proposes:

1. The KongSwap SNS DAO immediately hands over **full management and operational control** of the DAO (including treasury, all controlled canisters, backend, frontend, and administrative rights) to the **Doxa Foundation**.

2. The KongSwap brand, name, logo, and all existing infrastructure shall remain 100% intact. Doxa Foundation will operate **KongSwap by Doxa** (or simply continue as KongSwap) to ensure zero disruption for users and LPs.

3. Doxa Foundation commits to:
   - Protecting and growing remaining liquidity
   - Relaunching and scaling the DEX
   - Implementing proper governance and whitehat bounty policies
   - Using its execution track record to stabilize and expand the project

4. Upon approval, the current DAO principals/neurons will transfer all necessary permissions and control to a principal designated by the Doxa Foundation (@DoxaUSD).

This is the only credible plan on the table to **save the DAO**, protect LPs, and keep KongSwap alive as the leading DEX on the Internet Computer.

Vote YES to save KongSwap and give it a future under Doxa Foundation management.

Doxa Foundation is ready to act immediately after passage.

## **Summary** We request 40,000 ICP in funding from the KongSwap DAO for Q4 2025 to support ongoing research and development. This funding will cover: - Team compensation - SaaS subscriptions, hosting, and infrastructure - Equipment and administration costs - Travel and operational expenses ## **Current ICP treasury** As of now, the KongSwap DAO holds approximately ICP across various components: - [ICP treasury](https://dashboard.internetcomputer.org/account/f39d9b22c382c25f832fd1d3e6ad5216249623b204a7fc5498f991f4cf2df1e1): 160’243 ICP - DEX liquidity: ~20’000 ICP (KongSwap) Total: ~180’243 ICP ## **Delivered in Q2 and Q3 2025** We delivered on the majority of the roadmap for Q2 and Q3 2025. Remaining items are actively in development and tracked via this forum post: https://forum.dfinity.org/t/kongswap-q2-q3-project-update/57445 ## **Plan for Q4 2025** Our primary objective for Q4 is to continue **expanding KongSwap into a multichain platform**, enabling native integrations with additional ecosystems and enhancing cross-chain wallet compatibility. In parallel, we aim to ship key product innovations, bolster DeFi UX, and continue platform growth. **Multichain Expansion** We plan to roll out native integrations for: - Solana (which is shortly before release) - Ethereum L2 ecosystem (Base and BNB) This will also involve wallet-level upgrades to broaden user access. **Swaps & Liquidity Tools** - Launch of concentrated and single-sided liquidity possibilities - Native support for limit orders and twaps (close to release) - Referral program for growth and incentive alignment (close to release) Kong Earn - Launch kong Earn as a new exciting yield product for our users **Core Platform Enhancements** - Enhance prediction markets with the introduction of multichain tokens for new predictions - Support for automated trading strategies - Go live - Strategic integration with a lending market platform - Launch of a customizable airdrop tool Quality of Life Improvements - Fix minor bugs in wallet library - Improve state handling on LP management page for smoother UX. - Improve various other minor state related bugs on the frontend. - Improvements to token analytics pages to fall more in line with sites like dexscreener --------------------------------
